control_set.name: Innate Immunity Panel (curated)
control_set.provenance_notes: Positives: TLRs, NLRPs, MYD88/IRAK/TRAF adaptors, NF-kB subunits, JAK-STAT, and inflammasome caspases — all innate immunity signaling. Negatives: heat shock proteins — housekeeping chaperones with no direct innate immune signaling role.

description: Comprehensive innate immune signaling: TLR/NLR/NOD pattern recognition receptors INTERSECTED with downstream signaling adaptors (MYD88, IRAK, TRAF, NF-kB, IRF), UNIONED with JAK-STAT pathway and inflammasome caspases. Models the complete signaling cascade from pathogen recognition to transcriptional response.
name: Hs Innate Immunity Signaling Network

control_set.name: Pathogen Defense Panel (curated)
control_set.provenance_notes: Positives: defensins, complement factors, C-type lectins, Fc/phagocytic receptors — direct pathogen killing and engulfment. Negatives: autophagy machinery and MAPK cascade — intracellular processes without direct antimicrobial effector function.

description: Multi-layered pathogen defense: secreted antimicrobial peptides (defensins + cathelicidins with signal peptides), complement system components, phagocytic receptors (Fc receptors, CR3), and surface C-type lectin receptors. Models effector mechanisms that directly kill or engulf pathogens.
name: Hs Pathogen Defense Arsenal

control_set.name: Cytokine Panel (curated)
control_set.provenance_notes: Positives: interferons, interleukins, TNF superfamily — secreted immune signaling molecules. Negatives: HSPs (chaperones) and defensins (antimicrobial peptides) — not cytokine signaling.

description: Complete cytokine signaling network: interferons (alpha/beta/gamma/lambda) filtered to protein-coding, secreted interleukins (IL-1/IL-6/IL-10/IL-12 families), TNF superfamily members (minus ribosomal noise), and secreted chemokines. Captures the full communication network of immune cells.
name: Hs Cytokine Network

control_set.name: Autophagy Panel (curated)
control_set.provenance_notes: Positives: ATG core genes, beclin, LAMP, ULK1, WIPI, DRAM — autophagy/xenophagy machinery. Negatives: complement factors and interleukins — extracellular immune effectors, not autophagy.

description: Autophagy pathway for intracellular pathogen defense (xenophagy): ATG core genes (ATG2-ATG16), beclin complex, ubiquitin-autophagy crosstalk (ubiquitin genes with GO:autophagy annotation), all filtered to protein-coding. Critical for clearing intracellular Toxoplasma, Mycobacteria, and Salmonella.
name: Hs Autophagy & Xenophagy Machinery

control_set.name: Malaria Host Response Panel (curated)
control_set.provenance_notes: Positives: TLRs, interferons, complement, interleukins, NF-kB — genes known to be activated during malaria infection. Negatives: HSPs and defensins — not specifically malaria-responsive.

description: Human host response to Plasmodium infection combining RNA-Seq data from malaria-infected Gambian children (upregulated genes 2-fold) INTERSECTED with GO immune/defense response, UNIONED with hemozoin-stimulated interferon pathway genes. Also includes complement + TLR genes MINUS those downregulated during malaria. Models the complete human transcriptomic response to malaria infection.
name: Hs Malaria Host Response

control_set.name: Multi-Pathogen Response Panel (curated)
control_set.provenance_notes: Positives: interferons, NF-kB, caspases, TLRs, JAK-STAT, MYD88/IRAK/TRAF, TNF, interleukins — genes activated across multiple pathogen infections (T. gondii, T. cruzi, Candida). Negatives: HSPs and defensins — not transcriptomically responsive to these pathogens.

description: Cross-pathogen comparison of human transcriptomic responses: core shared response (T. gondii AND T. cruzi upregulated), Candida-specific response (MINUS shared protozoan response), innate immune genes upregulated by any protozoan, NF-kB pathway in Candida, and apoptosis genes in T. gondii + Candida. 15-node strategy covering 3 major pathogen classes: apicomplexa, kinetoplastid, and fungal.
name: Hs Multi-Pathogen Transcriptomic Response
